name: Prismatic sculpted double helix
description: Two substantial, rounded backbones in cool turquoise and warm coral. Pearl-like nodes catch a broad white key light; recessed base pairs and dark rear surfaces establish a clear over-under weave.
depth: Opaque tube surfaces, contact shadows, near-side highlights
motion: Continuous axial rotation with a restrained three-quarter sway

name: Polished twin-ribbon spiral
description: A pair of thick, smoothly wound metallic spirals, one champagne and one sea-green. Their curved cross-sections carry moving reflections while the rear coil falls into shadow, leaving clean open space between the turns.
depth: Rounded profiles, strong rim lighting, separate front and back coils
motion: A smooth corkscrew turn without flat waveform oscillation

name: Measured molecular ball-and-stick DNA
description: The measured 1BNA DNA heavy atoms form a dense, rotating molecular model with element-colored spheres and covalent display sticks. Rigidly repeated fragments fill the horizontal frame without stretching atom coordinates; the extended assembly is illustrative, not a measured long molecule.
material: Satin atomic spheres and shaded chemical bonds
depth: Actual atom coordinates, sphere shading, physical occlusion
motion: Rigid molecular rotation; no claim of simulated molecular dynamics

name: Illuminated engineering blueprint helix
description: A cyan three-dimensional construction study with pale structural rungs and fine cross-section rings. A recessed registration grid stays behind the model; forward contours are bright and rear-facing construction lines recede into blue shadow.
material: Technical cyan contours over dark solid cores
depth: Recessed grid, shaded cylindrical members, section rings
motion: Rotating engineering model inside a stationary drawing frame

name: Dual-color luminous glass helix
description: Teal and magenta light tubes twist around a dark central volume. Restrained halos surround solid, glossy tube bodies; bright cores remain readable, and opposing strands visibly pass in front of one another instead of blending into flat light trails.
material: Glossy colored light tubes with restrained bloom
depth: Opaque tube cores, shaded backs, luminous rims
motion: Axial rotation with reflections sliding across curved surfaces

name: Architectural wire-mesh double helix
description: A fine triangular cage wraps each dark tubular backbone. Cyan and amber edges describe real circular cross-sections, while hidden rear edges are occluded by the core so the structure reads as a volume rather than crossed zigzags.
material: Fine metallic cage around dark solid tubes
depth: Triangular surface topology, occluded rear edges, sectional ribs
motion: Rigid rotation that exposes changing faces of the mesh

name: Faceted isometric DNA sculpture
description: Jade and coral polygonal backbones carry broad, distinct light and dark faces. An orthographic three-quarter camera reveals the thickness of the rungs and nodes without changing their relative scale along the strand.
material: Satin faceted geometry with contrasting strand colors
depth: Three-quarter orthographic view, planar shading, solid joints
motion: Measured axial rotation through alternating illuminated facets

name: Volumetric suspended-particle helix
description: Thousands of persistent small particles occupy the surfaces and inner bridges of a double helix. Larger illuminated foreground particles and dimmer rear particles reveal its hollow volume, while the coherent body keeps its shape throughout rotation.
material: Lit micro-spheres in turquoise, lime, and coral
depth: True three-dimensional particle positions and size perspective
motion: A stable rotating particle sculpture with distinct foreground and rear layers

name: Mercury-and-opal liquid morph helix
description: Two continuous liquid-metal backbones carry broad silver and opal reflections. Small traveling changes in their thickness suggest surface tension, while attached rounded droplets merge visually with the tubes; the helix remains legible instead of dissolving into noise.
material: Clear-coated liquid metal and opalescent highlights
depth: Broad reflections, rounded menisci, dark reflected faces
motion: Continuous rotation with a subtle periodic surface ripple

name: Layered spectral holographic helix
description: Translucent cyan-violet shells surround darker structural cores. Fine contour bands, illuminated nodes, and view-dependent rim light separate the front surface from the interior without overwhelming the silhouette with glow.
material: Translucent spectral shells and fine luminous contours
depth: Layered solid cores, rim light, depth-ordered contour bands
motion: A rotating volumetric projection with a gentle traveling scan
